import_cub_classes: import the cub_classes list containing 200 bird species from the CUB-200-2011 dataset
import_waterbird_classes: import the waterbird_classes list containing landbird and waterbird habitat labels
reference_cub_classes: reference the cub_classes list to map model prediction indices to bird species names
reference_waterbird_classes: reference the waterbird_classes list to map binary habitat prediction indices to landbird or waterbird labels
list_cub_species: list all 200 bird species names available in the cub_classes constant for the CUB dataset
